user_request: Switch allocator to test after SSD improvement.
candidate: Repeat published mimalloc0.1.52/libmimalloc-sys0.1.49/native3.3.2, matching the earlier experiment. Opt-in feature changes Rust global allocator and routes aligned WAL allocations through matching std::alloc Layout(capacity,4096). Default remains System/libc; no C malloc override or allocator tuning. Address/Leak sanitizer builds use System. Retained async and hybrid SSD fixes remain byte-identical.
version_scope: This is a controlled repeat of the prior published Rust-wrapper/native combination, not a test of newer upstream mimalloc3.6.0. Exact locked/cached sources will be recorded.
protocol: SSD ext4 only. Per cell5warmups(oneperarm),3 alternating five-arm rounds. odd base_v7,old_v4,new_v4,old_v7,new_v7; evenreverse; warmupbase,oldv4,oldv7,newv4,newv7. base_v7=unchanged retained e7;old=paired new-source System, new=selected mimalloc. 1KiB values,2GiB SST, explicit v4/v7Parallel.30s initial cooldown,10s between runs,1Hzrecognized host-process audits. No build/test/profile overlap. All completed observations and stalls retained. No score-selected retries.
measurement: Timed throughput/p50/p99 and measured processCPU fromengineJSON. Child-lifetime Linux wait4peakRSS, faults and switches for exact engine PID, excluding launcher. Compare both formats independently because both allocators change; v7/v4 normalization diagnostic only. Record matched peaks with hashes, not a replacement for the paired results.
assessment: For each format/cell paired raw and arm-median throughput>=0.95,CPU<=1.05,p99<=1.10,DATAbytes equal andsync-count ratio<=1.05. Atleastone cell/format>=2%raw gain withCPU<=1.00. Compare paired Systemv7 against unchanged e7 as an independent control. RSSratio>1.20 is a review flag; prior memory investigation already establishes the tradeoff and this test records current RSS. These assessment rules do not activate a default allocator.
correctness: Outside-sandbox cargo make check with allfeatures(mimalloc), and full Systemnextest(all existing features except allocator) with zero retries. Alignment/content/cross-thread free regression test, plus existing WALownership/recovery/failpoints. Build and hash System and selected-allocator releasebinaries; activationproof separate from scoring. One excluded current-baseline SSDCPU profile before source edits.
decision: The request is an allocator test, not unconditional default adoption. Keep allocator source only if assessment passes and memory cost is acceptable under the measured tradeoff; otherwise restore the four modified manifests/sourcefiles and canonicale7 binary while preserving evidence. Never revert kept async/hybrid IO commits. NoPR/push; separate any retained source from evidence.
